verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit automatically reviews every PR within moments using multiple models. It explicitly detects low-quality AI-generated 'slop' PRs and can block merges via the request-changes workflow and pre-merge checks. It also applies agent guideline files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), loops with coding agents such as Claude Code, and offers a cross-repo Triage queue for handling high PR volume. Community reports are mixed: one user says it catches bugs Claude Code misses, while another found it too verbose and prone to false positives. missing for 10: independent evidence of review throughput or accuracy at AI-scale volume, consistent hands-on corroboration of signal-to-noise quality.
